default.description: Desktop capability — grants core IPC, native file dialogs for receipt intake, and writing camera captures to $APPDATA/captures (ingest_receipt deletes them once stored).

mobile.description: Mobile capability — grants core IPC, dialog-based file picking for receipt intake, and writing camera captures to $APPDATA/captures (ingest_receipt deletes them once stored). Camera capture uses the WebView's native HTML file input API (<input type='file' capture='camera'>).
